method: Independent read-only round against the supplied frozen inventory. Read AGENTS and every assigned deployment implementation, shell entrypoint, Go source, Python/root fixture, CI workflow, tooling script/test, configuration and ordinary documentation completely; truncated output was reread in bounded chunks. Reviewed permission and UID separation, descriptor/path validation, process-stop proofs, durable publication/recovery, source/runtime pins, HTTPS/DNS credential generations and migration CAS, deployment instructions, and test selection/reconciliation/full-run authorization. The maintainer-requested two consecutive complete clean rounds supersede the documented default three; no full run was attempted. Read the assigned feature-evidence documents as claims under review, never as prior proof of correctness, and did not open their historical audit/report links, WORKLOG, previous checkout or Git implementation history. Fully parsed all capability JSON, rejected duplicate keys, checked all 178 method/group/classification/assessment relationships and all 175 JSON schema pointers against current protocol, matched all 166 parameter-source declarations and raw hashes, read every distinct assessment/workflow and all method-to-public-workflow mappings, and validated all 559 structured source/test/evidence references without reading historical report targets. The 20 JSON evidence files and their Markdown index were fully read or losslessly structurally inspected; historical execution limitations were retained. Fully inspected the 1545 go.sum records for exact shape, unique module/version identity and valid 32-byte h1 sums, and matched all 195 go.mod requirements to source and go.mod checksums. Parsed every nonblank line of the 3120-line pnpm lock using its complete restricted YAML grammar, rejecting unknown structures and duplicate mapping keys; verified all 337 package/snapshot identities, 623 dependency edges, SHA-512 integrity shapes, all 22 direct importers against package.json, override/settings semantics and every distinct Node engine requirement. Used fixed Node and bundledPython only for read-only structural inspection and source verification. Before and after review independently recomputed all 1910 raw SHA-256 values with zero mismatches and executed scripts/snapshot.mjs; both snapshots remained the supplied digest. No source edit, deployment, full or targeted test execution, paid inference, personal credentials or real DNS/ACME/MCP/API call occurred. This report is the only written artifact.

findings.title: DNS Caddy test-count guidance is stale
findings.trigger: An operator or reviewer follows the affected/full Go verification instructions at deploy/README.md:438 and compares the documented expected coverage with the current Go test inventory.
findings.impact: The guide claims four top-level behavior tests and seven outcomes including subtests, while the current source defines six top-level tests and fourteen subtests (twenty outcomes including parents). This gives reviewers an incorrect expected test inventory and obscures the added build-pin and provider-parser coverage.
findings.reason: deploy/caddy_dns_source/main_test.go defines six Test functions at lines 25, 60, 99, 127, 146 and 171. Its three t.Run loops enumerate five build-pin cases, six provider configurations and three destination cases. The obsolete 4/7 statement is therefore inconsistent with current implementation and the tooling Go inventory.
findings.recommendation: Update the statement to the current six top-level tests and twenty outcomes, or describe the covered behaviors without a hard-coded count.
